semiconductor_relevance: High — HIWIN provides precision positioning systems and wafer handling solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: HIWIN specializes in nano-precision positioning stages and wafer transfer robots that enhance semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Their in-house developed linear motion guides, motors, and controllers are designed to meet the stringent requirements of semiconductor production.
capabilities: Nano-precision positioning stages compatible with PLP process
Wafer transfer robots with DD motors
High-precision XYθ stages for wafer handling
Customizable linear and rotary motion systems

regional_presence.Japan: HIWIN is exhibiting its advanced solutions for the first time in Japan, indicating a strategic focus on this market.
